item.tinkers_katanas.katana.description: The Katana is a single-edged blade designed for sweeping attacks against a group of opponents.
item.tinkers_katanas.fuma_shuriken.descr: The Fuma Shuriken is a large throwing weapon designed for dispatching foes at a distance.
item.tinkers_katanas.muramasa.descriptio: The Muramasa is a sinister katana forged by a legendary bladesmith. It harbors an insatiable lust for blood.
modifier.tinkers_katanas.bloodlust.descr: Taking hits makes you deal more and more damage
modifier.tinkers_katanas.bloodlust.encyc: Taking damage fills a capacity bar, which boosts attack damage by up to 20% at full charge
